provenance.description: Pointer back to the raw evidence this normalized record was derived from. Any field EdgeLab could not determine is null, never fabricated.

sourceSystem.description: e.g. kalshi_registry_snapshots, kalshi_discovery, bets_json, data_bets_json, pipeline_recommendations, clv_from_snapshot, f5_settlement, manual_entry

sourceFile.description: Repo-relative path to the raw/upstream file this record was ingested from

sourceKey.description: Key/index/ticker used to locate this record within sourceFile, when the file is not itself one-record-per-line

capturedAt.description: When the underlying evidence was captured/observed (may differ from ingestedAt)

ingestedAt.description: When EdgeLab's ingestion produced this normalized record
